name: ap_payment_preparation_xa_rollback
description: Failure workflow for ap_exception_resolution. It rolls back an active XA payment-preparation transaction. External settlement starts only after COMMIT and cannot cause this rollback workflow to run.

tasks.name: Rollback_Payment_Preparation_XA_Transaction
tasks.description: Instructs the MicroTx coordinator to roll the XA transaction back. Both participants - the ap-backend invoice write and the payment-service instruction - are discarded together.

inputParameters.terminationReason: Payment-preparation XA transaction rolled back; no invoice state or payment instruction persisted.
